notes: Route reaches further: the cluster map now preloads the offline road tiles ahead and stitches them, so the highlighted route runs all the way to your next turn (not just the on-screen bit). The 'Amazon Music' label no longer pops up over the map. New option in Settings (Media and nav) to hide the Map/Media/CarPlay buttons. Apple/Google only (Waze sends no turn data); mic stays working.
